name: voice
title: Clip that
about: Say "simple clip that", or your own phrase, and it saves a clip. Works offline with Windows speech recognition.

settings.label: Phrase
settings.hint: What you say to save a clip, at least two words. "Hey" or "okay" in front also works

settings.label: Show "Saving clip" first
settings.hint: The card shows up in the clip, then it saves 2 seconds later

settings.label: Beep when it hears you
settings.hint: The beep is in the clip too

settings.label: Sensitivity
settings.hint: Strict needs you to say it more clearly and triggers by mistake less often
